daily.today_energy: Mercury's moving through your sector of reflection—perfect day to journal those late-night thoughts that keep circling. Your vibe is quietly magnetic; people are drawn to your calm presence without you even trying.

daily.health: Your body's asking for slower, intentional movement today. Whether it's a walk, stretching, or just breathing intentionally, honor that need. Rest isn't laziness; it's your superpower recharging.
